project.name: Art Domains
project.purpose: Extends agentic working environments with structured instructions projected from stable sources of truth.
project.description: Distributable artificial resources within knowledge and work domains: structures, templates, processes, agent instructions, modes, and skills.

project.name: Art JS
project.purpose: Enable Art files to be authored as programs, with validation, language tooling, and automated projection to target formats.
project.description: Libraries and tools for working with Art MD as a programming language, including records, resources, modules, programs, program builders, validators, projectors, language services, and related tooling.

project.name: Art Lib
project.purpose: Build high quality, consistent, Cli and Tool experiences from composable units.
project.description: Shared libraries and tools for building CLIs and Tools.

project.name: Art MD
project.purpose: Express structured data in Markdown with an extensible language that enables human and machine authoring at scale and automated transformations.
project.description: Language specification and JavaScript libraries for extracting structured data into a MDAST derived AST, with an open construct registry. Provides parsing, validation, transformation, and serialization of Art MD content.

project.name: Art Work
project.purpose: Manage multi-repository development environments for parallel planning and execution.
project.description: Tools for discovering projects, managing knowledge and context resources, and operating across multiple checkouts: cloning, visualizing, synchronizing, and executing commands.

project.name: Artificials
project.purpose: Generate and manage (Art)ificial Driven Development environments.
project.description: A collection of tools and resources to generate and manage knowledge artefacts and agent instructions.

project.name: Artisans
project.description: Creative and experimental micro projects developed entirely using Artificials.

project.name: Noodlestan Conventions
project.purpose: Distributable Noodlestan conventions written in Art.
project.description: Conventions packages for Noodlestan stack, including Typescript, JSX, Solid JS, and SCSS.

project.name: No Comply
project.purpose: Context-aware UI system built with SolidJS and modern CSS.
project.description: SolidJS layered library ecosystem spanning foundational types, accessibility primitives, contexts and services, composable controllers, a themeable component library, and developer tooling.

project.name: Noodlestan Web
project.description: Repository of Noodlestan websites — typically built with Astro.

project.name: Purrception
project.purpose: Extract and compose metadata from source code and artefacts.
project.description: Collection of abstractions and tools for building metadata extraction pipelines from local and remote sources using heuristics, schemas, and factories.

project.name: Purrfect
project.purpose: Extract, compose, and expose metadata to support the discovery, interpretation, and operation of artefacts.
project.description: Collection of composable tools and abstractions for building metadata extraction pipelines, aggregations, indexes, visualizations, and metadata endpoints.

project.name: Purrpose
project.purpose: In browser source code and metadata transformations.
project.description: Single-purpose utilities for in-browser transformations: JSX/TSX compilation, SolidJS JSX transform presets, and Shiki-based syntax highlighting.

project.name: Purrtrait
project.purpose: Transform, render and visualize metadata about source code and artefacts.
project.description: Collection of tools for rendering code, visualizing metadata, and creating representations for humans and tools.
